_doc: Retail-side field spec for the execution+dataflow trace (docs/plans/execution-flow-trace.md). Maps each instrumented engine VA -> the declared payload the Frida agent reads at that call, joined to the port's CALL_TRACE_* fields by (va, field-name). VA keys + global VAs accept 0x-hex or decimal. src: global (read DAT at va) | arg (Frida onEnter arg index, 0-BASED: index 0 = first param) | argderef (deref arg[index] + off) | retval (onLeave). type: i32|u32|f32|hex. NB: indices are Frida's standard 0-based InvocationArguments (index 0 = first cdecl param) — validated 2026-06-05 against FUN_00404efc's dst/src/diffuse params.

0x47be2f.name: tick_now_ms
0x47be2f._note: FUN_0047be2f — pure QPC clock read (no game state). The scheduler samples it at a frame position that legitimately differs port↔retail (retail seq1, port seq45) and is doubly irrelevant under turbo's forced virtual clock. Excluded from chain alignment so it can't shadow a real divergence.

0x47b73c.name: input_poll
0x47b73c._note: FUN_0047b73c — the engine's DirectInput device poll (GetDeviceState into the 256-byte key buffer). Under the TAS harness the port SUBSTITUTES this entirely: replay_input_poll/segtrace_input_poll write g_input_state[].buttons directly from the recorded trace, so the real input_poll() (with its CALL_TRACE_ENTER(0x47b73c)) never runs on the port (src/main.c). Retail still calls its real poll. A deliberate harness-substitution structural divergence — both sides receive identical synthetic input by construction and the device read consumes no game RNG. Excluded from chain alignment so it can't shadow real sim-leg divergences. Revisit if a scenario ever depends on engine-side input side-effects.

fields.name: duration
fields._benign_note: Dormant while phase==0 (fade_tick returns early without reading it; src/fade.c:69). Retail's 170 is leftover from the intro→title fade the port skips; port's is 0. Benign ONLY for fade-idle frames — if debugging an ACTIVE fade (phase!=0), drop this mark and scrutinize.

0x404efc.name: render_quad_add
0x404efc._note: FUN_00404efc(param_1=dst* {x,y,w,h}, param_2=src* {l,t,r,b}, param_3=tex* (w@+4,h@+8), param_4=diffuse). Read at onEnter, before the body mutates param_1[2]/[3]. Joins to src/render_quad.c render_quad_add CALL_TRACE_*.

0x405354.name: render_quad_flush
0x405354._note: FUN_00405354 — 2D quad batch flush. vcount = DAT_00647e0c, read at onEnter before the flush zeroes it.

0x49a59e.name: scene_title_sim
0x49a59e._note: FUN_0049a59e — title-screen menu state machine. The salient persisted menu state, read at onEnter from its DAT_096435xx globals (mapping documented in src/scene_title.h). Port-side names + read timing in src/scene_title.c scene_title_sim_default (CALL_TRACE_BEGIN_STUB). The port body is a subset (stub-marked); these INPUT fields must still track retail frame-over-frame — a [data] divergence here flags a skipped engine branch as load-bearing.
